reports.title: Lime Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: “Our momentum remains strong, positioning us to deliver another solid quarter of growth and profitability in Q4 even as we invest strategically in select markets and expand LimePrime,” said Ann Gugino, CFO. “We are particularly encouraged by the early trends in LimePrime engagement and retention, where the average rider is now generating two times the adjusted gross profit per non-

subscription rider. We plan to continue to invest in long-term growth opportunities like LimePrime and market expansion, while also maintaining unit economics discipline and remaining focused on maximizing long-term free cash flow. We are confident in our outlook and remain committed to driving durable, profitable growth and creating long-term shareholder value.”
